items.title: וין: תלויות + פאטץ' 1.5 + אתחול + אימות
items.instruction: 2rb5e7k8lc: run timeout=900 powershell -NoProfile -Command "echo PYVER; python --version 2>&1; echo STEP_NUMPY; python -m pip install -q --no-input numpy 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1; python -c 'import numpy; print(`"NUMPY_OK`", numpy.__version__)' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; echo STEP_DIFF; python -m pip install -q --no-input diffusers transformers accelerate safetensors 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1; python -c 'import diffusers; print(`"DIFFUSERS_OK`", diffusers.__version__)' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; echo STEP_TORCH; python -c 'import torch; print(`"TORCH_OK`", torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available())' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; echo STEP_PATCH; $d='C:\ShimiStudio\ShimiStudio-Local\studio'; curl.exe -s -o $d\patch15.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunraz/shimi-land/main/downloads/studio15/patch15.py; python $d\patch15.py; echo STEP_RESTART; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter `"name='python.exe'`" | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -like '*app.py*'} | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep 2; Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden python -ArgumentList 'app.py' -WorkingDirectory $d; Start-Sleep 10; echo SRV=$(curl.exe -s -o NUL -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:7861/editor --max-time 8); echo STEP_VERIFY; $h=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:7861/api/history -TimeoutSec 20; echo NET_ITEMS=$($h.items.Count); echo DONE"
